BCPL offers home delivery to Boone County residents of any age who cannot visit because of a temporary or permanent physical limitation or lack of transportation. Staff arrange delivery and collection every four to six weeks; weather or mechanical problems can cancel visits. Register through Outreach or call 859-292-3394.
https://www.bcpl.org/outreach
venue_official

All Boone County residents - regardless of age - are eligible for outreach services if they are unable to visit the Library due to a temporary or permanent physical limitation and to those who lack transportation.

Our Outreach Services staff will contact you to discuss the types of materials you like and to make arrangements for delivery. Materials will be delivered and picked-up every four to six weeks until you no longer need this service.
Visits may be canceled for inclement weather or mechanical issues.
Complete the registration form linked below or call 859-292-3394 .
